$comment: Recto's tokens beyond the family kit's world.json schema (docs/family/README.md §3): every glass density, all seven springs, shape, depth, the mark and the voice. Every value is copied from the source named beside it, never redrawn; when a token changes there, change it here. Nothing in the app reads this file.
name: Recto

theme.light: equal from day one; follows the system or Settings (tokens.css §2)

page.rule: the page is the brightest thing on screen and is never themed

accent.name: lime
accent.job: The armed tool and the one primary action of a view, plus the focus ring's light band; always touching ink, never on the page.
accent.lightTheme: ink fill with a lime label

light.technique: in-house WebGL 1 fragment shader at 1/8 resolution, ±0.5 LSB in-shader dither (AU-3); the Library's aura is a static CSS twin
light.rule: Still at rest; moves on events (arrival, drag-over, success), drifts only on the empty Library and About, settles within 5 s; never within 64 px of a page; capped at 0.6 under lit glass.
light.note: #bbed26 is the aurora's lime (light). It is not the action lime #c8fb3d: a button is never #bbed26.

glass.rule: One glass in five densities; no glass in glass; at most 4 glass surfaces at rest; smooth at every tier; every tier has a solid twin (Glass Solid, reduced transparency).
glass.blur: σ per surface from the coverage registry (c >= 0.985), not a fixed value
glass.rim: 0 0 0 1px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.5) edge; inset 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 0.12) inner light

depth.rule: controls never glow, only light glows

type.family: 'Inter Recto', 'Inter Recto Fallback', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif
type.case: sentence case, no uppercase labels; tnum on changing numbers
type.rule: Each app keeps its own faces (family vision §2.5): Recto stays Inter Recto.

shape.rule: every bar, chip and text button is a 999 px capsule; icon buttons are circles

motion.temperament: Rest is still; motion answers. Zero bounce for anything a click, tap or key starts; idle frames = 0.

familyGrammar.$comment: A reading of Recto's springs in the family's four names (F1), proposed in README §4.3. It renames nothing in Recto.
familyGrammar.pop: pop (one small glyph only, never a surface)

motion.signature: the capsule morph: one glass pill changes its own width and height (dock ⇄ Markup palette ⇄ Pages bar ⇄ Compare ⇄ Locked), radius 999 throughout
motion.reduced: spatial springs become instant; fades keep 100–150 ms

mark.name: Dengeli R
mark.gradient: linear 46.75°, mint #69EAA3 → lime #CBFF5F at 59 % → yellow lime #EDFA6D
mark.rule: No recolouring, rotation, outline, shadow or effects; gradient on dark grounds only; the owner is its designer.

voice.register: plain, factual, sentence case; proof before promise
voice.promiseSource: Library welcome card, message library_line (apps/web/messages/en.json; tr.json has its own Turkish line)

makersDot.inProduct: none; the R is Recto's sign
makersDot.atExits: edk. only at exit points (About credits, press kit), with its dot in lime, if the owner agrees
